trends.title: Trend Radar
trends.sub: What people are talking about right now, in Arabic and English. Every row says where it came from.
trends.degraded: Partial: one or more sources failed, this is the last good copy
trends.needWorker: Set the Scout URL in Settings to get trends automatically
trends.proof.title: Top videos under this hashtag
trends.empty: No trends yet. Tap {icon} or wait for the next scan (every 6 hours).
trends.emptyFilter: Nothing trending under this filter right now
trends.momentsSub: From the 3z calendar, works without Scout. Prepare content two weeks ahead.
trends.momentsEmpty: No moments in the next two months
trends.manualSub: Sources with no free API; a few seconds each.
trends.ritual.title: Instagram sounds this week
trends.ritual.steps: Open Instagram → Reels → the audio icon → Trending. Copy the names of the top 3 sounds and paste them here. Two minutes.
trends.ritual.formatPh: e.g. before and after, POV, one take…
trends.ritual.note: You type these from Instagram's own list; the date is the day you pasted them.
trends.err.unconfigured: Set the Scout URL and token in Settings first
trends.err.auth: The token was refused. Check Settings
trends.err.network: Could not reach the Worker. Check your connection
trends.err.rateLimited: The Worker is busy, try again in a moment
trends.err.upstream: The Worker answered with something we did not understand. Try again
